qualification.scope: Isolated native MFC Properties windows and catalog; actual WM_ENABLE notifications on fixture-owned controls. Five stable pulses, background start and stop, and retained description text/selection. No personal catalog or installed-app automation.
qualification.buildCache: Reused verified current native core objects; rebuilt the complete Properties fixture. Initial attempt explicitly refused a stale Bridge object, then succeeded after the production build refreshed it.
qualification.browserRegression: capture.test.cjs: seven checks; streaming-capture.test.cjs: 25 checks. Both exit 0. Four capture source hashes match the separately qualified 7.31 receipt.
qualification.limitations: No physical mixed-monitor, assistive-technology, keyboard-focus, or live installed-app qualification. Does not establish full IDM parity.
